A 6-pack of Nuka-Cola! Share with your friends or drink them all yourself! 

Includes: Nuka-Cola x 6 

- GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. SUBJECT TO PER CHARACTER MAX WEIGHT-

A variety pack of Nuka-Cola flavors! Share with your friends or drink them all yourself! 

Includes: 1 Nuka-Cola Cherry, 1 Nuka-Grape, 1 Nuka-Orange, 1 Nuka-Cola Cranberry, 1 Nuka-Cola Wild, 1 Nuka-Cola Dark 

- GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. SUBJECT TO PER CHARACTER MAX WEIGHT-

A 6-pack of Nuka-Cola Twist! Share with your friends or drink them all yourself! 

Includes: Nuka-Cola Twist x 6 

- GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. 
SUBJECT TO MAX WEIGHT-
Don’t get caught out in Appalachia with a broken weapon, fix it up fast with a repair kit

When you can't make it back to your C.A.M.P., a Scrap Kit can scrap all your junk and then send it directly to your stash!  

 USE FROM YOUR PIP-BOY UNDER THE MISC ITEMS TAB. SCRAP KITS WILL BE GRANTED TO THE CHOSEN CHARACTER.

A collection of useful materials to help you survive in the Wasteland, from your friends at Vault-Tec. 

- SCRAP THIS AT A WORKBENCH TO ACCESS THE MATERIALS. -
Some caps to use in Appalachia!
Open for you and your friends! You and those who are close by get an XP Boost and a random effect for 1 hour!
This new Perfect Bubblegum will replenish your hunger and thirst, and you will not go hungry or thirsty for an hour!

Drink this and you will gain +50 Carry Weight for a half hour. 

- AVAILABLE FOR GOLD BULLION. UNDER THE FOOD AND DRINK TAB AND GRANTED WHEN ENTEING ADVENTURE MODE.
SUBJECT TO PER CHARACTER MAX WEIGHT.

A pack with four perk cards (and a bubblegum joke)! 

- SELECT THIS ITEM IN THE PERK MENU. PERK CARD PACKS WILL BE GRANTED TO THE CHOSEN CHARACTER. -

Open a Scout's Banner for you and your friends! You and nearby players receive various combat effects that have a chance to trigger whenever you kill enemies. Lasts for 1 hour! 

- SCOUT'S BANNERS ARE UNDER AID IN THE PIP-BOY. SCOUT'S BANNERS WILL BE GRANTED TO THE CHOSEN CHARACTER.-

There's always money in gold! Some gold bullion to buy from the various vendors of the world! 

- GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. SUBJECT TO PER CHARACTER MAX-

Some Perk Coins to help you become even more Legendary! 

- GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. WILL BE GRANTED TO THE CHOSEN CHARACTER.-

Legendary Scrip to exchange with Murmrgh! 

-GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. SUBJECT TO PER CHARACTER MAX-

Improve your chances of hooking the big one with this Improved Bait! 

- CAN BE SELECTED BEFORE CASTING LINE DURING FISHING. GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. SUBJECT TO MAX WEIGHT.

Get the top-of-the-line bait for your never-ending line-casting escapades!
Greater chance of cathing rarer fish than Improved Bait.

- CAN BE SELECTED BEFORE CASTING LINE DURING FISHING. GRANTED WHEN ENTERING ADVENTURE MODE. SUBJECT TO MAX WEIGHT.
